note: Inflation feed for the Economics watch list. Refresh with node scripts/update-inflation.mjs (after-close push). mom and yoy are percent changes, one decimal, as published. The Fed's inflation target is 2% on PCE. Each point carries status preliminary, revised, or final; a revision overwrites the value and keeps revisedFrom. Never hand-edit.

series.title: CPI, all items
series.sourceLabel: BLS CPI-U CUSR0000SA0 (seasonally adjusted, for mom) and CUUR0000SA0 (not seasonally adjusted, for yoy)

series.title: Core CPI, all items less food and energy
series.sourceLabel: BLS CPI-U CUSR0000SA0L1E (seasonally adjusted, for mom) and CUUR0000SA0L1E (not seasonally adjusted, for yoy)

series.title: PCE price index
series.sourceLabel: BEA via FRED PCEPI, seasonally adjusted

series.title: Core PCE price index, excluding food and energy
series.sourceLabel: BEA via FRED PCEPILFE, seasonally adjusted
